anomalies.description: A man in a red plaid shirt is struck and thrown backward onto a bench, with visible dust/debris indicating impact; the attacker (long-haired man) is seen mid-motion initiating the strike at f5 and standing over the fallen man by f10.
The attacker stands over the fallen victim lying motionless on the bench, indicating the victim is helpless; no resistance or movement from the victim is visible.

After being knocked down, the man in the red plaid shirt lies motionless on the bench while the long-haired man stands triumphantly over him with arms raised, indicating a one-sided attack on a helpless victim.
